description: Zero‑dependency, TypeScript‑first edge‑ready framework that fuses Express simplicity, Fastify speed, and AI‑driven routing for Node, Bun, Deno & Cloudflare Workers.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the 2026 hype around AI‑enhanced edge computing: position yantravese as the only framework that ships with built‑in LLM‑driven route generation, zero runtime overhead, and native support for the newest edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Bun, Deno). Emphasize TypeScript‑first ergonomics, automatic OpenAPI/GraphQL scaffolding, and out‑of‑the‑box observability (OpenTelemetry) to capture both performance‑critical and AI‑first developers.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese for its AI‑generated routing that cuts boilerplate by up to 80% while keeping full TypeScript safety.
Benchmarks show 2‑3× lower latency than vanilla Express on edge runtimes, thanks to Fastify‑level request handling and HTTP/3 support.
Zero‑dependency, single‑file install means no npm‑install bloat, instant cold‑start on Workers and Bun, and a frictionless developer experience.
